Then, retrieve the A Time of War Scenario box, which will contain all components needed for this story. As the Storybook progresses, it will ask you to put items into play from this box. Be sure to keep it nearby.

All players who voted against building the Barracks receive a Flag token and flip it {{1=...|Unified Monarchists|...}} side up{{4=?| and gain 2 Resources of their choice}}{{5=?| and gain 2VP}}.
If any player's Caretaker remains on the Barracks at the End of the Generation, they immediately lose 5VP.

All players count up the total number of {{0=| |Knowledge cubes|Ingredients|money}} remaining in their possession. The player(s) with the most {{0=| |cubes|Ingredients|money}} immediately gains a token and places it in their Quarters.
Any player with a token immediately gains {{0=...|2|...}}VP.

Remove all player pieces from the board when performing the End of the Generation as normal, but do NOT discard your completed Experiments. You will still choose a completed Experiment to Store, but keep all your other completed Experiments nearby.

Remove all player pieces from the board and perform the End of the Generation. Return any unused <icon=S3_SickleToken>, <icon=S3_ShieldToken>, and <icon=S3_WoodenFigureToken> tokens to the Scenario box.
Perform the End of the Generation as normal, but do NOT discard your completed Experiments. Remove all player pieces from the board. Return any unused , , and tokens to the Scenario box.

Retrieve the tokens from the Scenario box and place them in a supply nearby.

Any player with a token from Generation 1 gains 2 tokens. Discard this token to the Scenario box.

Then,
Any player with a face-up Flag token matching the {{0=...|Separatists|...}} gains 1 token.

Any player with a face-up Flag token matching the {{1=...|Unified Monarchists|...}} gains 2 tokens.

Retrieve the Advanced Weaponry Experiment cards. Shuffle these cards and place them face-down nearby to form their own deck.

Each player then draws an Advanced Weaponry card.

Turn to page 4 of the Village Chronicle. Retrieve the Temporary Housing Estate Upgrades.
Place the Suspicion Marker on space {{0=...|7|...}} and the Marker one space to the left.{{1=?|
Then, since this is a 3 player game, pass the starting player marker clockwise 1 additional time.}}
One of the buildings in town was targeted by the {{0=...|Unified Monarchists|...}}. Turn to page {{1=...|5|...}}.

{{0=...|Anna|...}} gains {{1=|1 and 1 Resource of their choice.|1 Resource of their choice and moves the Marker 1 space to the left.}}

If they have not already done so, {{0=...|Anna|...}} may flip their Flag token to the {{2=...|Unified Monarchists|...}} side if they wish.
Do NOT perform the End of Round actions at this time. You will be instructed to do so once a few events have been completed.

The Monarchy is not pleased.|is fortunate as the Monarchy has decided not to penalize them this round.}}

In turn order, decide whether you will support the troops in town by providing quarters. If you choose to support them, Pay $1 to immediately build the Temporary Housing Upgrade.

Once all players have chosen, continue to the next page.

Award {{0=...|2|...}}VP to any players who chose to quarter.

All other players MUST take the Temporary Housing Estate Upgrade.
Award {{0=...|2|...}}VP to each player who chose to quarter.

{{0=?|The player that offered the most money also gains 3VP. If there is a tie, all tied players gain this bonus.

}}Then, all players with money in their fists pay that money to the supply.

Any player that offered at least $1 towards the bribe, draws 1 Compulsion.

Then, all players return their money to their Quarters.

Move the Marker {{0=?|2 spaces|1 space}} to the left.

All players must discard a completed Experiment card back to the supply.{{1=?|

All players who voted NAY lose 2 and may draw an Advanced Weaponry card.}}
{{0=?|All players who voted YAY gain 1 and may draw an Advanced Weaponry card.|The player who did not win the bid gains 2 and may draw an Advanced Weaponry card.}}

Gain 1 Compulsion.

Nothing happens. Discard the {{0=...|Sickle|...}} token to the scenario box.

Retrieve the Suspicious Barn Estate Upgrade and build it for no cost. (If expanding into a new Estate plot, you do not have to pay the cost listed.)

Then, discard the {{0=...|Sickle|...}} token to the scenario box.
Gain 2VP. Then, discard the {{0=...|Sickle|...}} token to the scenario box.
Draw an Experiment card from the deck of your choice. Then, discard the {{0=...|Sickle|...}} token to the scenario box.
{{0=...|Anna|...}} gains 1 and loses 1VP.
{{0=...|Anna|...}} gains 1 .

{{0=...|Bob|...}} and {{1=...|Anna|...}} now count how many Levels they have moved their Journal Track forward in {{2=...|Biology|...}}.

They then count how many of their completed Experiments (including stored) are of the type {{2=...|Biology|...}}.

Each player adds these two numbers together to determine their total individual scientific prowess. (For example, Level 1 in {{2=...|Biology|...}} plus 2 completed {{2=...|Biology|...}} Experiments would equal a total of 3.)
{{0=...|Bob|...}} and {{1=...|Anna|...}} both gain 1 .

{{0=...|Bob|...}} must place their Self into Lost. This piece cannot be reclaimed for the remainder of this Generation.{{1=?|

{{0=...|Bob|...}} gains their Caretaker piece from Lost (if possible). As outlined in their will, in order to execute actions posthumously in case of their untimely demise.}}

Also, {{0=...|Bob|...}} gains a .
Remove all player pieces from the board and perform the End of the Generation. Players keep all <icon=S3_WeaponToken> tokens they acquired.
Turn to page 12 in the Village Chronicle.
Retrieve the Time Machine Update card from the Scenario box and give it to the player working towards this Masterwork.

Retrieve the Paradox tokens . Each player places 1 Paradox token on each of their completed Experiments (with the exception of their single stored Experiment).

Experiments with Paradox tokens are considered incomplete. They can be completed with a Perform Experiment action as normal in order to return the token to the Scenario box.

Turn to page 13 of the Village Chronicle. Flip your Masterwork Experiment face-down - it cannot be completed during this Generation. Return the token 1 space to the left of the Suspicion Marker.{{0=?|
Then, since this is a 3 player game, pass the starting player marker clockwise 1 additional time.}}

Each player retrieves their second Caretaker from Lost and places it in their Estate. This piece represents your parent working on Experiments in the lab.
Turn to page 14 of the Village Chronicle.
Gain {{0=...|3|...}}VP and a Knowledge cube of your choice.
Retrieve the three Time Machine Repairs cards from the Scenario box and place them, Experiment side up, in view of all players.

Gain 1 .
Draw 2 Experiments from the deck(s) of your choice.

Then, gain a token and place it on one of your completed Experiments. This Experiment counts as an incomplete Experiment and follows the token rules.

Return the {{0=...|Sickle|...}} token to the scenario box.

Discard an Experiment with a token on it (also discard the token).

If you have no tokens, gain a token and then discard it.

Return the {{0=...|Sickle|...}} token to the scenario box.

The player with the Storybook token on their Estate {{0=| |gains 1 Knowledge cube of their choice|gains 1 Ingredient of their choice|gains $2}} and gains a Compulsion. Then, return the Storybook token to the supply.
{{0=?|The player|Any player}} who chose to pay $2 to acquire a Flag token of the {{1=...|Separatists|...}} pays $2 and flips their token to the opposite side.
{{0=...|Bob|...}} must immediately discard one Estate Upgrade from their Estate and gains 2 . If they do not have an Estate Upgrade built, they must instead lose 5VP.
{{0=...|Bob|...}} remained silent and discards 1 Resource of any type from their Estate or returns a Servant to Lost.
All other players must discard 2 Resources of any type from their Estate or return a Servant to Lost.

The player(s) with the most tokens remaining on their Experiments gains 4VP and may immediately advance their lowest Journal Track 1 space at no cost (if multiple tracks are lowest, they may choose).

You must have at least 1 token to gain this bonus.
Any player that does not have a piece of their color on the Barracks must lose 5VP.

Remove all player pieces from the board and perform the End of a Generation. Return your Masterwork face-up once again. Any <icon=S3_ParadoxToken> tokens remaining on your Experiments are moved into your Quarters.
